pull approximately 18" (45cm) of dental tape, wound around fingers and hold tautly. leave an inch or two to work with. gently guide tape between teeth and gums using an up and down motion. be sure to curve around the base of each tooth and clean beneath the gumline. repeat using a clean section between each tooth.
with their molded, angled y-shaped head, these flossers are designed at the perfect angle to quickly work their way between back teeth to ensure no tooth is left unflossed.
this product is to be used once a day (every 24 hours), every day.
